audience.text: Java developers building applications that require reading, writing, and editing Excel .xlsx workbooks without runtime third-party dependencies.

capabilities.text: Create, load, rename, and manage worksheets, control visibility, and access cell collections for reading and writing values.
capabilities.title: Workbook and worksheet management

capabilities.text: Apply font, borders, fill, alignment, number format, and protection via `Style` objects on individual cells.
capabilities.title: Cell styling and formatting

capabilities.text: Define validation rules and apply conditional formatting to cell ranges using `Validation` and `FormatCondition` APIs.
capabilities.title: Data validation and conditional formatting

capabilities.text: Inspect load diagnostics and repair issues when loading malformed workbooks using `LoadOptions` and `LoadIssue`.
capabilities.title: Load diagnostics and repair

capabilities.text: Embed images, add cell comments, and create Excel tables (ListObjects) with column definitions and totals rows.
capabilities.title: Embedded content support

capabilities.text: Create 18 chart types programmatically and preserve 7 ChartEx types loaded from existing workbooks.
capabilities.title: Chart and shape rendering

limitations.text: Saving is limited to .xlsx format only.
ChartEx types (Waterfall, Treemap, Sunburst, Histogram, Box and Whisker, Funnel, Map) cannot be created programmatically.
Formulas are stored and round-tripped but the library is not a full spreadsheet calculation engine.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic Excel workbook manipulation in pure Java without requiring Apache POI at runtime.
Supports robust loading of corrupted or malformed XLSX files via strict mode toggles and repair options.
Provides data validation and conditional formatting capabilities for enforcing and styling cell rules.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Cells FOSS for Java is a free, open-source Java library for creating, loading, modifying, and saving Excel .xlsx workbooks, targeting Java 17 with no runtime dependencies.

workflows.name: Build and test
workflows.text: Developers build the project with `mvn package` and run tests with `mvn test` using JUnit Jupiter.

workflows.name: Release workflow
workflows.text: Releases are published to Maven Central via the `maven-central-release.yml` GitHub Actions workflow.

workflows.name: Quick start
workflows.text: Developers create workbooks, write values, apply styles, and save to .xlsx using `Workbook`, `Worksheet`, and `Cell` APIs.
